notes: Two teams scoring goals inside a lined perimeter is Sports on its default space-bounded, the bounded field or court, and the author's compact quarter-field answer only sets its size. Full Stadium is the preset because the prompt asks for the dressing outright — turf, lines, goals, benches, lights, crowd and scoreboard — and I added the field-sport options it leaves out, all of them named in the brief: faceoffs at the start and after goals are startpoint-play, the goal mouths and goalie saves are trigger-scoring, the crease rule and ground-ball resets need trigger-bounds, and the arena's markings are marker-distance. The bleachers are the only thing carrying a route, and stepped seating is relief without overhang, so this stays on P0 with tiered rather than earning a modifier. Decided without a user: the Skills Challenge practice area with its targets and cones is built as an annex on the same surface beside the arena rather than as a separate map, since nothing requires the two to be hidden from each other and one continuous build keeps this on the proven pipeline; the controls, dodges, stamina, progression and callouts are gameplay and never reach layout.
